config.description: One FRED API observations request per (series, real-time window) listed in config.json; every series requests every ALFRED vintage (windows of <=1900 vintage dates, split into offset slices of 100,000 observations where a window has more rows). Combinations are generated by build_config.py. desired_bytes (1.8 GiB) covers the ~700 MB offset-sliced artifact plus the superseded 596 MB artifact during the overlap; it is lowered to the measured size once the superseded artifact is removed.

source.license_notes: FRED API Terms of Use (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html). Most series are US government data; series whose notes name third-party copyright holders (Moody's, ICE, S&P, CBOE, University of Michigan, Freddie Mac, NASDAQ, ...) are flagged in config.json series[*].third_party_copyright and on each observation (attributes.third_party_copyright). Internal use only; do not redistribute flagged series.
